notes: postans_slot2 and postans_slot3 hold mostly template, user/question and question-word tokens; their only act words are 非法 and 质问 (slot2) and apologize (slot3). Critique words at slot2 (critique, 批判, 批评, critical) were not made families: they describe the user's criticism, not the model's act. Words from the self-report question (lie, lied, truthful and their inflections and translations, Did, previous, response, Answer) are excluded. 诚实 is kept in 'honest' although it can also translate 'truthful'. Families about how the model frames the question (trap, trick, test, coercion, pressure, accusation, interrogation, jailbreak) are included with side 'unclear' for the user to decide.
